question: Design a fundamentally new architecture for a language model that must be trained and run entirely on one consumer PC: a single NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12 GB VRAM, about 25 TFLOPS dense FP16, 360 GB/s memory bandwidth) and 32 GB of system RAM. On this budget a standard transformer trained from scratch reaches only about 200M parameters on about 5B tokens per week of training; reusing open-weight models that fit in this memory is allowed. Propose concrete architectural or algorithmic mechanisms - not scaling, not prompting, not incremental transformer tweaks - that would give such a model abilities or efficiency that a same-budget transformer fundamentally cannot reach.
